format.description: The file to create: "pptx" for a PowerPoint deck or "pdf" for a PDF document. The guide has a section on the Markdown of each.

markdown.description: The whole document as Markdown, front matter included, written as the guide describes for the format.

audience.description: The version to write, as the guide's section *Versions* describes: "customer" (the default) leaves out what is marked internal and the solutions, "internal" shows what is marked internal, "trainer" also the solutions. Wins over the front matter's 'audience'.

mode.description: "generate" (the default) writes the file; "check" writes nothing and returns every problem in the Markdown at once, with statistics.
